title: 第2329章 探望双亲第2328章 魔化改造
content_zh:
白莲神宗宗主峰
红烛摇曳，风光旖旎，美得不可方物的灵嫣然和玉面郎君郑钰郎共赴巫山云雨，一夜辛劳，双修造娃，数个时辰过去，直到东方露出鱼肚白，方才作罢。
激情后相拥而眠，感觉极好。
直到午时三刻，太阳高照，整个宗主峰被耀眼的日光照的暖洋洋的，率先醒来的郑钰郎，温暖宽厚的大手掌在灵嫣然平坦紧致的小腹上，轻轻抚摸，口中喃喃自语。
“夫人怀风儿的时候，为夫抚摸夫人的小肚肚，能感应到风儿的回应。”
“还记得当年造人根本没有刻意，顺其自然，很快就怀上了！如今风儿长大了，继续和夫人努力造娃，咋就这么难，数年啊！辛劳了多少个日日夜夜，夫人的肚皮咋越来越平坦紧致，是存心气我？还是不够努力！”
郑钰郎一脸郁闷地自我反省，很想找出哪点不尽人意。以完善后弥补。
“当时怀上风儿是无心插柳柳成荫，今日努力造娃确是有心栽花花不发。唉！”
把耳朵贴到灵嫣然平坦紧致的小腹上，却没有听到希冀中的胎音。
“二宝啊！三宝啊！什么时候才能得偿所愿？”
躬着身子，在灵嫣然光洁如玉的额头上亲吻后，一脸惆怅的郑钰郎，眉心微蹙。
“夫君，看把你愁的！皱什么眉？顺其自然就好！”
温柔软糯不失娇媚的悦耳声响起，灵嫣然一脸满足地抬起头，性感红唇凑到夫君郑钰郎耳边，吐气如兰，安抚一下躁动焦虑的心。
“夫君，你我如今的武道境界，已经是这方天地屈指可数的存在，再想孕育子嗣本就不易，何必刻意为之，更不必心生焦虑。”
“天若遂人愿，好事自然成。世间多烦恼，庸人自扰之！”
葱白玉手抚摸着夫君郑钰郎俊帅脸庞，眼波流转，春心荡漾。
“夫君这张脸怎么也看不够！即便不是为了生孩子，也情不自禁地想和夫君亲亲抱抱！”
灵嫣然一脸温柔，性感红唇捕捉到夫君棱角分明的温热嘴唇，深深地印了上去。触电般的感觉迅速蔓延全身，双眼微眯，心跳加速，刹那间的怦然心动，亦如新婚夜的幸福甜蜜。
就在二人准备再次激吻一场，忽然床头的通讯腰牌震动起来。
本不想理会的郑钰郎，正要阻止灵嫣然查看腰牌，柔声笑道：“夫人，认真点，说不定这次能好梦成真，心想事成！”

灵嫣然却招手将传讯腰牌弄到了手上，打开接听。
“娘亲，风儿想你了！”
郑风熟悉的声音响彻在灵嫣然耳畔，令她瞬间激动起来。
“风儿啊！娘亲已经很久没有看到你了，什么时候来看看娘亲，娘亲给你做好吃的！”
郑钰郎没有想到是宝贝儿子的传讯。当即傻眼了，看来和夫人的造人计划得缓缓了！
“娘亲，风儿就在白莲神宗两万里之外的翠屏峰，和宗主峰遥遥相望！”
郑风的声音充满惊喜，马上就要看到父亲和娘亲，喜悦的心情透着几分颤栗。
“不会吧！事先不说一声，冒冒失失地就找了过来。”
郑钰郎赶紧起身，穿好衣袍，整理仪容，心头又惊又喜。
灵嫣然早已一溜烟跑开了。
“宝贝儿子来了，夫君去接一下。”
看到灵嫣然跑去厨房的方向，郑钰郎会心一笑。
content_en:
The main peak of the White Lotus Sect
The red candles swayed and the scenery was beautiful. The extremely beautiful Ling Yanran and the jade-faced gentleman Zheng Yulang went to Wushan Yunyu together. They worked hard all night to build a baby. Several hours passed, and they did not give up until the white fish belly appeared in the east.
Sleeping in each other's arms after the passion, it feels great.
Until three quarters of noon, the sun was shining brightly, and the entire sect's main peak was warmly illuminated by the dazzling sunlight. Zheng Yulang, who woke up first, put his warm and generous palm on Ling Yanran's flat and tight belly, gently caressing it, and murmured to himself.
"When Madam was pregnant with Feng'er, her husband could touch Madam's belly and feel Feng'er's response."
"I still remember that I didn't have any intention to create a baby back then. I just let nature take its course and I got pregnant very quickly! Now that Feng'er has grown up, I continue to work hard with my wife to create a baby. Why is it so difficult? It took several years! After so many days and nights of hard work, my wife's belly is getting flatter and tighter. Are you trying to spite me? Or you are not working hard enough!"
Zheng Yulang reflected on himself with a depressed look on his face, wanting to find out what was unsatisfactory. Make up for it after improvement.
"When I was pregnant with Feng'er, I had no intention of planting willows and willows to create shade. Today, when I work hard to make a baby, I have no intention of planting flowers and flowers. Alas!"
She put her ear to Ling Yanran's flat and tight belly, but she didn't hear the expected fetal sound.
"Second treasure! Third treasure! When will we get what we want?"
After bowing and kissing Ling Yanran's smooth and jade-like forehead, Zheng Yulang, who looked melancholy, frowned slightly.
"Husband, look how worried you are! Why are you frowning? Just let nature take its course!"
A sweet, soft and charming voice sounded, and Ling Yanran raised her head with a satisfied look on her face. Her sexy red lips came to her husband Zheng Yulang's ear, and she exhaled like blue, soothing her restless and anxious heart.
"Husband, you and I are already at the level of a handful of people in this world at our current level of martial arts. It is not easy to conceive an heir anymore, so why should we do it deliberately, let alone feel anxious."
"If God fulfills people's wishes, good things will happen naturally. There are so many troubles in the world, and it's up to others to disturb them!"
Green white jade hands caressed the handsome face of husband Zheng Yulang, his eyes were full of excitement and his heart was full of love.
"I can't get enough of my husband's face! Even if it's not for the purpose of giving birth, I still can't help but want to kiss and hug my husband!"
Ling Yanran had a gentle face, and her sexy red lips captured her husband's angular, warm lips and pressed them deeply. An electric shock-like feeling quickly spread throughout the body, eyes narrowed slightly, heartbeat accelerated, and the sudden pounding of the heart was just like the happiness and sweetness of a wedding night.
Just as the two were about to kiss passionately again, the communication badge on the bedside suddenly vibrated.
Zheng Yulang, who didn't want to pay attention to it, was about to stop Ling Yanran from checking her waistband, and smiled softly: "Madam, be serious, maybe this time your dream will come true, and all your wishes will come true!"
Ling Yanran waved her hand to get the summons badge and opened it to answer the call.
"Mom, Feng'er misses you!"
Zheng Feng's familiar voice rang in Ling Yanran's ears, making her instantly excited.
"Feng'er! Mom hasn't seen you for a long time. Come and see me sometime. Mom will prepare delicious food for you!"
Zheng Yulang did not expect that it was his precious son's summons. I was immediately dumbfounded. It seems that my wife and I’s plan to create a human has been slowed down!
"Mother, Feng'er is at Cuiping Peak, 20,000 miles away from the White Lotus Divine Sect, far away from the sect's main peak!"
Zheng Feng's voice was full of surprise. He was about to see his father and mother, and his joy was a bit trembling.
"No way! I just came here without saying anything beforehand."
Zheng Yulang quickly stood up, put on his clothes and tidied up his appearance, feeling surprised and happy at the same time.
Ling Yanran had already run away quickly.
"My precious son is here. Husband, go pick him up."
Zheng Yulang smiled knowingly when he saw Ling Yanran running towards the kitchen.
